description: Andrew lies unconscious in the car, gradually regaining consciousness after being rescued. The driver Rabin miraculously appears to save him, and the agents regroup amidst the crisis.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Trust me, I'm quite a good driver."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Attack at Justice Plaza, over ten people, come quickly."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Frankfurt station received.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I hope we can last ten minutes."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player6>'s Drive Auto check result:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Pull out the submachine gun and prepare to lay down suppressive fire on them.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Oh dear, what's wrong with this car?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Damn it, Schiller, hurry up, isn't the sidewalk quite spacious?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Schiller accidentally collided with a roadside tree.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Schiller glanced at the sidewalk and decided to give it his all and try again from the green belt.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The mountains and soil listen to your wishes. Whatever the karma and retribution, fate has already slumbered in your palm.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Switch off the safety of the submachine gun, hide the gun body behind the car door, only lean out half my head, and stare nervously at the approaching crowd nearby.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Schiller floors the accelerator and charges forward again, this time more directly, breaking the tree.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player6>'s CON check result:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Fuck, Schiller, where the hell are you driving!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s CON check result:

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Sorry, sorry, sorry!!!!!!!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5, having leaned their head out, directly had an intimate collision with the window frame and passed out.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Boss! Boss! Wake up! What should I do!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The car's condition isn't great either; black smoke is pouring out from the damaged hood.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Have to grip the steering wheel with my left hand, hold the pistol in my right hand, lie down on the steering wheel pretending to be dead, and keep observing the rearview mirror.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: One person smashes the car window with a baseball bat.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Time for a sharp turn and reverse.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Schiller pretends to be dead in the driver's seat. Roll Luck.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player6>'s Luck check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Luckily, the glass shards didn't cut the carotid artery or anything like that.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew is panicking inside, thinking if this person attacks him again, he'll pull the trigger with his trembling hand.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Taking advantage of him reaching through the window to open the door, Andrew fires first.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're good at quite a few things.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: This person was shot in the head by you.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Andrew pulls the driver down, trying to keep him from possible gunfire. Also gives him two slaps.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Three checks for <player2>'s Handgun 55, results:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Andrew falls into a coma. His thoughts drift far, far away.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Young people are in good health, they fall asleep as soon as they hit the pillow.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Returned to the time of eating hodgepodge in Scotland.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The story record of the Algorithm of the Heart has continued to open, currently 2574 texts recorded. Continue! There will definitely be gains today!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The agents split into two groups. Andrew and player5 stayed near the police station to keep watch, while Gray and David went to the Spiegel newspaper office and received Margaret's help. You obtained a lot of intelligence you wanted to know from the newspaper's library and archives.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: After bidding farewell to the reliable reporter and the library with vast amounts of information, return to the car with David. "This trip was quite fruitful. I hope everything goes smoothly on their end too."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Contact Andrew and the driver via radio. "Yeah, hope we can finish up and go home soon."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: David receives no response. Besides occasional flickering noise on the radio, there is no warm or hopeful reply; the other end remains silent.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What's going on, is this thing broken?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "What's going on? Aren't they in the car?" Wondering internally, "Either try contacting again in half an hour, or contact the Frankfurt station directly."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Weren't they keeping watch in the car? Did they encounter some situation and both went out? Ask the Frankfurt station, hope they haven't run into trouble."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David contacts the Frankfurt station to inquire about the situation of the other two. "Have you received any messages from the other two agents? We currently can't reach them."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Three quarters of an hour ago, we received a distress signal from Andrew and player5. They reported being surrounded by an unidentified group near the Rule of Law Square. However, when the nearest Frankfurt station agents arrived, they were not found. There was a car accident and signs of a gunfight at the scene. We are currently making every effort to locate the two."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Should we prioritize completing the mission or searching for our companions? David is a bit indecisive. He turns his gaze to Gray.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "How could this happen?! Weren't they at the police station entrance? What did they encounter?" Alison finds it hard to believe. "Should we request instructions from headquarters?" Alison feels the situation is getting out of control.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "We will report the situation to headquarters, and we will continue to monitor the situation. Johnsen and Gray will continue to prioritize completing the work." Reply to the Frankfurt station. Contact headquarters, inform the boss that things are out of control, we've even lost people inside. David starts the car and slowly circles along the main streets according to the map, observing for any followers.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Let David drive, I'll pay attention to whether anyone or any car is following us.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Roll Spot Hidden.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Spot Hidden check result: D100=33/25 Fail. Truly unfortunate! As bad as if all your money from selling hawthorns was robbed! But you will try again tomorrow. <player4>'s Spot Hidden check result: D100=37/60 Success. A close success. Adventurer, boldness always has its rewards.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: No suspicious individuals or following vehicles detected for now.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Then David drives a few more circles, goes through the downtown area to confirm no one is following, then heads to the safe house provided by the Frankfurt station.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: After arriving, observe if there are any abnormal situations near the safe house.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You circle several times, confirm no one is following, and drive towards the Frankfurt safe house.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Go.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: But after driving for a while, you find the intersection ahead blocked by several rows of neatly placed orange-yellow barriers. Several road workers wearing reflective vests and safety helmets are gathered together, seemingly repairing something.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Check the map to see if there are other routes to the safe house? Turn on the car radio, listen for any traffic condition related broadcasts.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Observe the clothing and items these workers are carrying. Do they look like they are carrying any weapons?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Spot Hidden.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Then David waits for Gray to assess the situation before taking a detour.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Spot Hidden check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gray notices that although their actions appear professional, subtle details reveal a hint of deliberate affectation—they don't show the haste and disorder typical of routine maintenance, but instead proceed methodically, intentionally stalling, as if waiting for a predetermined moment.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "These people aren't right, let's take a detour," Alison urgently tells her colleague.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Immediately steer away from this road and take another route.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: David and Gray alertly turn around and take another road.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're quite skilled at many things.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: This road is visibly much more remote compared to the original one, taking a detour around a circle.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: So remote, so terrifying. David concentrates, trying to drive with a clear mind.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: However, the advantage is there aren't many cars; if anyone is tailing us, it would be obvious at a glance.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison is on edge. "What kind of force is after us?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Neo-Nazis or something else, who knows? We're just here to retrieve a document."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: After passing the second-to-last intersection, your tense nerves finally relax a bit. Turning at the last intersection will lead straight to the Frankfurt station safe house.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Idea check result:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Anyway, slow down first; if anything seems wrong, immediately turn around and flee.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Your peripheral vision catches the rearview mirror inside the car. The reflection hits you like a thunderbolt straight to your forehead, causing an involuntary shudder—a large truck is rushing toward you at at least eighty miles per hour.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Get out of the way!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Then David immediately hits the accelerator to speed up. If there's a side road, immediately swerve into it to evade. If not, screw whoever is doing maintenance, just crash through.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: There's such a thing?

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Have Gray ready the submachine gun to open fire.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Quickly send a message to Frankfurt station requesting backup, then ready your weapons to face the enemy.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: David directly crashes through the barriers; those road workers had already taken cover to the side.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David curses Frankfurt station in his mind, immediately steering into the street with the safe house. "I'll slow down at the safe house entrance later. You get out with the submachine gun and pistol, and I'll keep leading them in circles."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Still splitting up? Wouldn't it be better to leave together through the sewers?" Alison grips the smoke grenade on her person.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: After this intersection, you encounter no more barriers and gradually approach the bustling city area.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Alright, let's stick together. We've had enough of the downsides of splitting up."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The hustle and bustle of everyday life brings you a sense of security; attacking in a public place would count as a terrorist act.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Near the bustling area, they probably won't dare to ram our car at eighty miles per hour. David parks the car opposite the safe house and enters with all equipment.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Quickly enter the safe house with the document and equipment.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You park the car opposite the safe house.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Spot Hidden check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gray notices something is off. It's rush hour right now, but the neighborhood where the safe house is located is eerily quiet. Moreover, you see police officers not far away.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player2> wants to discuss something with me privately? Well done, I won't tell anyone the content.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Continue contacting the Frankfurt station, or should we just head back to the embassy district for refuge?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Why is it so quiet, and why are there police in this area?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "How did the Frankfurt station's safe house security get so compromised?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: This police officer seems to have spotted your car. He turns his head and says something into his walkie-talkie, then raises his pistol and takes cover behind a wall.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "They're coming for us. Charge the safe house or drive away?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "The Frankfurt police are working against us."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Send a message to the Frankfurt station.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The Frankfurt station does not respond.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Continue driving towards the downtown area, thinking of a solution.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "**! I'm starting to suspect the Frankfurt station is leading us into a trap. Whatever direction we go, run fast."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "I'll drop you off in the busiest part of downtown, and I'll keep driving to draw them away. Miss Gray, get ready to disguise yourself and get out."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Okay, be careful."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David observes the surroundings, stops the car in the most crowded place to let Alison out, and continues driving in circles himself.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison uses whatever she has on hand to change her appearance as drastically as possible in the eyes of others.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Attribute modification command, supporting the following sub-commands:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The cosmetics Gray has on hand are not enough for you to apply a heavy makeup that even your own mother wouldn't recognize.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then the only option is to quickly find the nearest public phone booth and call the boss.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David keeps an eye on the rearview mirror, waiting for Gray to get out of the car before continuing to draw the attention of those sons of bitches.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Several police cars swarm towards this direction like ants.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Quickly call the boss and report the situation. We're being targeted by the local police.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Relying on the memorized map to circle around the police, pistol already at the ready. Hoping Gray can find help in time, but for now, David can only pray for his own luck.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Also, the Frankfurt station is unreliable.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Let me see, you're good at quite a few things.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: As soon as the call connects, before you can even start explaining in detail, you can hear Turner's malicious voice, "Congratulations, now that you're enjoying wealth and honor, you still want to drag your superiors down with you?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Can my spy knowledge determine what Turner's words mean?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "What, not planning to admit it? Or have you eaten too much Soviet sausage and forgotten how to speak English? Should we switch to Russian? You'll need to get used to it more in the future."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Completely baffled by his words, "We encountered major trouble during the mission. Two colleagues have been attacked and are missing. Now we're being pursued by local police, and the Frankfurt station's safe house is also under surveillance."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Oh, you don't know? Let me fill you in then."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We met with Soviet agents? All four of us, with some Soviet agent whose identity was confirmed by headquarters?" Alison expresses doubt.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "But, two and a half hours ago, headquarters received a report from the Frankfurt station that Lev Mikhailovich player5 and player6 mysteriously disappeared, suspected to have defected to the KGB station in Frankfurt."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The Frankfurt station notified us that Andrew and player5 were attacked, called for help, and have gone missing, and demanded we go to the safe house. When we arrived, we only found a truck attempting a direct assassination and heavily armed police lying in wait."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: There is silence on the other end of the phone for a few seconds.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What kind of chance?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Listen, Brandt, who accused you, is a senior, high-ranking official in MI6, and he has photos as evidence. I'm just a small section chief in a marginal department, and your direct superior. Defending you would be suspicious and baseless, understand?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We understand your difficulty. So what chance do we have to change this?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "You have only one chance: uncover the truth of this matter! Brandt wouldn't falsely accuse you for no reason; you must be involved in something. And the only thing you encountered in Frankfurt is that bastard Haddin's escape and disappearance case, understand?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We'll do our best. Hope we're lucky enough." Alison already understands she's lost all support in a foreign land.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Also, your fake identities are compromised. Remember Standard Bank?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We remember. We'll activate that identity."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Hurry! Headquarters already inquired about me. I temporarily brushed it off. Go to the headquarters safe house and the bank to get what you need before tomorrow. I can't guarantee the bank and safe house will be safe after tonight!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Received. Hope we can return to report." Alison is filled with determination.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Lastly, headquarters decrypted a telegram: 'Osprey begins driving away the fish.' Radio call sign: Troupe."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Received. Thank you for the warning."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "You can say you have enemies everywhere now. You must stay on high alert at all times! If anything happens to you, I'll do my best to arrange for your relatives."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Take out the map and find the bank's location. Is it far from where I am now?

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David, relying on his familiarity with the map, drives through the downtown area. At a turn, using the cover of the turn, he opens the car door and jumps out, letting the car continue forward. He rolls on the ground to dissipate force and then dives into a shopping mall.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The story Algorithm of the Heart recording has resumed. Currently recorded text: 2909.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: @player3 David's truck crashes into the storefront of a street-side shop. The shop owner, suffering an unwarranted disaster, screams in shock, attracting the crowd's attention.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David leaves the scene without hesitation amidst the chaos and looks for an opportunity, such as a mall restroom, to disguise himself.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player3>'s Disguise check result:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Since a quick and successful disguise isn't possible, David memorizes the map and uses complex terrain to shake off pursuit.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Disguising in a restroom tests one's skill, and with limited time, David only changes his hairstyle.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: David takes off his jacket, leaving only his suit, walks to the next bus stop on the commercial street, and takes a bus to the bank.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: I want to see how far I am from the bank.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The bank is in the city center, not far from you.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then Alison blends into a crowded place, finds a restroom, and tries disguising again.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s Disguise check result:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: It is now 19:30 Central European Summer Time.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then Alison will research how to get to the headquarters safe house.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The headquarters safe house is located in Offenbach. Unless you have a car, it will take some effort to get there.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Alison estimates how long it would take to get there by taxi and how much it would cost. Then, use clothes to slightly cover the face and try to hail a taxi to take me to a location one block away from the safe house.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Mountains and soil listen to your wishes. Regardless of what karma and retribution may be, fate has already fallen asleep in your palm.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Gray waited 10 minutes before finding a car willing to take him to Offenbach, and it cost an extra 10 Marks.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Is his radio on?

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The car radio is playing a pop song.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Then pay him an extra 15 Marks, tell him I want to rest for a while, and ask him to turn off the radio.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The driver readily agrees to this request and doesn't speak to you the entire way.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: After making the call, I suddenly realize the bank is closed at this hour. For safety's sake, I should meet up with my teammates first. However, there's still a guy covered in blood lying in the back seat. After some thought, I'll first change my outfit simply, turn up my collar and put on a hat to cover my face, then drive towards Offenbach. On the way, I'll stop at small shops to buy a blanket, some cosmetics, clothes for disguise, and some medicine, finally taking small roads out of the city. On the way, I'll turn on the radio to listen for any related news. The blanket is to cover the guy in the back seat.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Just asleep, and he also took a tumble.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: [Background music fades, transitioning to a news broadcast tone]

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "??? Why do these people sound so much like us?" After a moment, I figure out the reason and angrily slap the steering wheel. "Damn it, those bitch-born sons of dogs at the Frankfurt station. I knew that old man was no good."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Lying obediently in the back seat.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That old bastard is in cahoots with those smugglers, right? When I catch you someday, I'll definitely practice my skills on you."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5's angry strike makes the car shake. Andrew, in his drowsy state, wakes up groggily.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Mom, I'm hungry."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Cursing non-stop while taking small roads out of the city, occasionally checking the rearview mirror to see if anyone is following.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "I want stew. My stomach hurts."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "So you're not dead? It wasn't a waste of effort saving you then. Do you remember what happened before you passed out?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Where am I... I'm alive!"
